text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The long-awaited sister showdown has 
finally arrived. The spectating fans 
displayed a fierce, overwhelming 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neither Vivlos nor Verxina had any 
intention of yielding victory. The 
sisters' all-out clash at the Victoria 
Mile was about to begin!
